objectives.text: Compile a source file with javac and run the resulting class with java
Run a single source file directly with java Hello.java and say when that shortcut is enough
Fix a program from a compiler error message by locating its file, line and cause

minutes.basis: Measured in the java-basics module PR on 2026-10-13. modeledP50: p50 of the frozen authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py run on the current artifact.html bytes. modeledWorstPath: modeledP50 plus 2.0 minutes for the worst required route recorded as routes.wrongTwice in qa-paths.json: reading the feedback on a wrong prediction (0.5), one wrong attempt and its feedback in each practice activity (1.0) and the apply retry in its second representation (0.5). aboutLabel and budget = ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)), within the 15 minute ceiling; F4 and F5 topic budgets total well under the 120 minute day. Re-measured on 2026-11-09 for the DESIGN.md re-authoring: the same frozen estimator on the re-authored artifact.html bytes gives modeledP50 9.05 and modeledWorstPath 11.05 (P50 plus the same 2.0 minute worst route); the new page anatomy (topic bar, timeline, Your task, Activity checks, back links and Previous/Next) adds required reading. aboutLabel and budget rise to 12, still ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)) within the 15 minute ceiling.
